articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and 2M Token Context
articles.summary: Anthropic officially launched Claude 4, featuring a 2 million token context window and a new 'deep reasoning' mode that shows step-by-step chain-of-thought processes. The model sets new benchmarks on graduate-level math and coding tasks, outperforming GPT-5 on several industry-standard evaluations. Anthropic also announced expanded enterprise partnerships with Salesforce and SAP.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaFold 4 Predicts Full Cellular Protein Complexes in Real Time
articles.summary: Google DeepMind unveiled AlphaFold 4, which can now model entire cellular protein interaction networks rather than individual proteins. The system runs predictions in near real time, enabling pharmaceutical researchers to simulate drug binding across thousands of protein complexes simultaneously. Early access has been granted to 50 academic research institutions worldwide.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Operator Pro: Autonomous Agent Platform for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI expanded its Operator product into a full enterprise platform called Operator Pro, enabling businesses to deploy autonomous AI agents that manage multi-step workflows across internal tools and APIs. The platform includes a new visual workflow builder and built-in compliance guardrails designed for regulated industries like finance and healthcare. Beta customers including JPMorgan and UnitedHealth report 40% reductions in manual processing time.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Agency Issues First Major Fines to Three Tech Giants
articles.summary: The newly operational EU AI Enforcement Agency handed down its first significant penalties, fining Meta, ByteDance, and a European AI startup a combined €480 million for violations of high-risk AI system transparency requirements. The fines relate to undisclosed algorithmic decision-making in hiring and credit-scoring tools deployed across EU member states. Legal experts say the rulings signal aggressive enforcement posture ahead of the Act's full implementation deadline.

articles.title: Microsoft Integrates RAG-Native Search Across Entire Microsoft 365 Suite
articles.summary: Microsoft announced that retrieval-augmented generation is now deeply embedded across all Microsoft 365 applications, allowing Copilot to dynamically pull from an organization's entire document, email, and calendar history with cited sources. The update introduces a new 'knowledge graph' layer that maps relationships between documents and people within an enterprise. IT administrators gain granular controls over data access scopes to address privacy concerns raised by security teams.

articles.title: Meta's Chameleon 3 Sets New Standard for Unified Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: Meta AI published research on Chameleon 3, a unified model capable of interleaving text, images, audio, and video within a single token stream without modality-specific adapters. The architecture achieves state-of-the-art results on cross-modal reasoning benchmarks and can generate coherent video narratives from text prompts in under 10 seconds. The model weights are being released under a permissive open license for research use.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Systemic Risks from Unchecked AI Agent Proliferation
articles.summary: Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute released a landmark report documenting emerging risks from the rapid deployment of autonomous AI agents in critical infrastructure and financial systems. Researchers identified 17 documented incidents in the past year where agent chains produced cascading errors that required emergency human intervention. The report calls for international coordination on agent behavior standards and mandatory kill-switch requirements for high-stakes deployments.

articles.title: Mistral Releases Mistral Edge 2B: A Powerful On-Device Model for Mobile and IoT
articles.summary: French AI company Mistral launched Mistral Edge 2B, a 2-billion parameter model specifically optimized for on-device inference on smartphones and IoT hardware without cloud connectivity. The model achieves performance comparable to much larger models on common assistant tasks while fitting within a 1.2GB memory footprint. Samsung and Qualcomm have already announced integration plans for their upcoming device lines launching later this year.
